healthScore.title: Health & readiness
healthScore.notFound: "{{appName}}" couldn't be found. It may have been deleted, or belong to a different instance than the one you're signed into.

sessionLink.invalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

deleteApp.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteApp.description: This stops and removes the app's containers, then deletes the app. If its node is unreachable the app is still deleted and cleanup retries until it succeeds. This cannot be undone.
deleteApp.pendingDescription: Its containers are not removed yet ({{reason}}). Cleanup retries automatically.

cascadeDelete.label: Also delete everything inside
cascadeDelete.hint: Removes every app and database in it and their containers. Volumes are kept. If something cannot be removed, nothing else is lost and you can run this again.
